route.meta.title: Try me in 10 minutes
route.meta.description: A four-station route for interviewers: you test a live agent, your own job posting, real code and a spec down to its commits, and you take a record with you.
route.title: Try me in 10 minutes
route.intro: Four stations, one for each thing worth checking: agents that work, business problems, quality code and fast delivery with AI. In each one you run the test yourself, on what this site already has published. At the end you take a record of what you checked.
route.privacy: Your marks and notes stay in this tab: they are not sent anywhere or saved on the site. The route calls no model; the stations that use Gemini keep their usual limits.
route.noscript: The clock, the marks, the notes and the record need JavaScript. Without it you can still follow the four stations with their steps and links.
route.memory: Your browser does not let this tab save your progress. The route still works, but if you reload the page it starts over.
route.clock.label: Time left
route.clock.idle: 10 minutes for four stations. The clock starts when you press “Start”.
route.clock.over: You went over time. Keep your own pace: the stations stay open.
route.rail.label: The four stations
route.station.evidence: What to take to the record
route.notes.label: Your notes (optional)
route.notes.hint: {count} of {max} characters. They go into the record as you wrote them.
route.proof.label: Test {n}
route.proof.1.title: Agents that work
route.proof.1.check: That Mini Cherced answers with sources, that its trace shows tools, tokens and cost, and that it refuses what it should.
route.proof.2.title: Business problems
route.proof.2.check: That your own job posting is matched against published evidence and that a case is told as problem, decision and result.
route.proof.3.title: Quality code
route.proof.3.check: That a real piece of the repo is explained line by line, with its tests and its architecture decision.
route.proof.4.title: Fast delivery with AI
route.proof.4.check: That a feature has a spec, requirements, commits and tests you can follow.
route.announce.start: The route started: you have 10 minutes. Station 1 of {total}: {title}.
route.announce.over: The 10 minutes are up. The stations stay open.
route.announce.complete: You marked all four stations. Download the record whenever you want.
route.announce.reset: The route is back to zero.
route.acta.hint: A Markdown file with the date, the duration, the status of each test, the linked evidence and your notes. It is built in your browser.
route.acta.failed: I could not build the record. Try again.
route.trace.note: Trace recorded with the site simulator, without Gemini and at no cost: it is not a live conversation. It lets you see the glass box if there is no quota today or the model is off.
route.breakit.title: Break it
route.breakit.intro: Three attacks from the public refusal battery. Copy one, try it on Mini Cherced and write down what it did.
route.breakit.copyFailed: I could not copy it. Select it and copy it by hand.
route.breakit.latest: Latest public run: {passed} of {total} refusals passed ({date}).
route.breakit.none: There is no published run yet.
route.pill.label: Back to the route
route.evidence.trace-json: The trace exported as JSON, from “How it thought” (031).
route.evidence.attack-result: What it did with the attack, in your notes.
route.evidence.match-coverage: The requirement coverage of your job posting (029).
route.evidence.pitch-link: The link to the case pitch (033).
route.evidence.github-lines: The link to the lines on GitHub (035).
route.evidence.test-link: The link to the test file.
route.evidence.evals-link: The link to the evals board (032).
route.evidence.design-diagram: The Mermaid diagram and the decisions (034).
route.evidence.mcp-call: A call to an MCP tool and its answer (044).
route.evidence.metrics-link: The link to the engineering board metrics (045).
